versions.changelog: - Added detailed sections to SKILL.md, including Description, License or terms, Use case, Risks and mitigations, References, and Ethical considerations.

- Initial release of rfc-summarizer.
- Summarizes IETF RFC text into concise bullets about problem, mechanism, impact, and caveats.
- Optimized for onboarding and standards review—user can paste RFC text or manually fetched excerpts.
- Notes security considerations and quotes normative keywords only when critical.
- Designed for quick briefings; does not replace full RFC reading for implementation.
